raw: Van der Brempt I. 6.0 Ikone J. 77'

commentary.text: 90+6' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+4' Koni De Winter (Genoa) is first to the rebound but his shot is blocked. Wow, what an escape there for the opposition.
90+4' Alieu Fadera (Como) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
90+2' Ivan Smolcic (Como) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Alberto Arena had an easy-decision to make.
90+2' Alessandro Gabrielloni (Como) is unable to control an accurate defence-splitting pass properly and one of the defending players reacts well to rob him of the ball.
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.
90' Vitinha (Genoa) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Alberto Arena stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning.
89' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Stefano Sabelli (Genoa) comes onto the pitch so that Brooke Norton-Cuffy can be given a rest.
88' Alex Valle will be replaced by Ivan Smolcic (Como).
88' Cesc Fabregas has decided to make a change. Yannik Engelhardt (Como) replaces Maxence Caqueret.
88' Lucas Da Cunha (Como) swings in a promising cross from the free kick, but one of the defenders does a perfect job to avert the danger.
87' Patrizio Masini (Genoa) knocks his opponent down with an over-the-top tackle. Como have a free kick.
86' Alberto Arena blows his whistle and it's Vitinha (Genoa) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
84' Junior Messias (Genoa) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
84' Edoardo Goldaniga (Como) is able to continue to play.
83' Edoardo Goldaniga (Como) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
81' Substitution. Morten Thorsby makes way for Alessandro Zanoli (Genoa).
81' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Genoa.
80' Junior Messias (Genoa) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. The referee points to the corner flag and Genoa will take a corner.
80' Alberto Arena shows a yellow card to Johan Vasquez (Genoa) for his blatant foul.
77' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Ignace Van der Brempt (Como) comes onto the pitch for Jonathan Ikone.
77' Referee Alberto Arena sees the trip by Alieu Fadera (Como) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle.
76' Lucas Da Cunha (Como) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
75' Jonathan Ikone (Como) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. Como have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
74' Aaron Martin (Genoa) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.
74' Junior Messias (Genoa) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. Genoa force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
71' Substitution. Alieu Fadera (Como) in, Gabriel Strefezza out.
71' Cesc Fabregas has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Alessandro Gabrielloni (Como) replacing Patrick Cutrone.
71' Morten Frendrup (Genoa) commits an ugly challenge. The referee sees it and immediately blows his whistle.
69' It looks like Brooke Norton-Cuffy (Genoa) saw red with that tackle. Alberto Arena won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
67' Kristian Wilson prepares a substitution. Honest Ahanor is replaced by Andrea Pinamonti (Genoa).
67' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Vitinha (Genoa) will replace Jeff Ekhator.
66' Nico Paz (Como) creates a yard of space for himself and tries an effort from distance, but it's blocked.
65' Gabriel Strefezza (Como) makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box after picking up a pass, but produces a poor effort that sails high over the bar.
65' Aaron Martin (Genoa) takes the free kick and sends the ball into the penalty area. The opposition's defence outnumbers the attacking players inside the box and they manage to make a clearance.
64' Alberto Arena blows the whistle, Maxence Caqueret (Como) is penalised for a foul.
63' Gabriel Strefezza (Como) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
59' 1 - 0 Patrick Cutrone feeds the ball through to Gabriel Strefezza (Como), who picks up the pass inside the box and quickly sends it into the top left corner! The goalkeeper was helpless. 1:0!
57' Junior Messias (Genoa) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the left side of the target, but Jean Butez easily deals with the threat.
56' Lucas Da Cunha (Como) produces a dangerous low pass into the penalty area, but the defence manage to cut it out.
54' Jeff Ekhator (Genoa) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
53' Lucas Da Cunha (Como) sends over a poor, overhit cross from the corner kick and the ball goes out of play.
53' The ball is cleared after Maxence Caqueret (Como) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. Como get a corner.
51' A long pass finds Patrick Cutrone (Como) unmarked, he looks up and hits a weak shot from mid-range which drifts well wide of the left post.
50' The resulting corner from Aaron Martin (Genoa) is cleared by the defence.
50' A lofted cross from Brooke Norton-Cuffy (Genoa) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area. Genoa have been awarded a corner kick.
49' Johan Vasquez (Genoa) manages to dispossess his opponent of the ball, but he commits a foul in the process and the referee blows his whistle.
48' Brooke Norton-Cuffy (Genoa) swings it in and Honest Ahanor gets on the end of it, but Jean Butez shows good awareness and comes off his line to thwart the move.
47' Jonathan Ikone (Como) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Alberto Arena blows his whistle for a foul.
46' Kristian Wilson makes a switch. Junior Messias is coming on in place of Lior Kassa (Genoa) at the start of the second period.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+2' The match has reached half-time.
45+1' Alex Valle (Como) brings his opponent down. Alberto Arena has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul.
45' 1 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Lucas Da Cunha (Como). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.

44' Gabriel Strefezza (Como) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort. Good work from Como as they win a corner.
42' A quickly taken corner by Como.

41' A sweet pass finds Lucas Da Cunha (Como) on the edge of the box, and he drills the ball towards the bottom left corner. Nicola Leali is almost caught out but pulls off a brilliant save at the last second. The referee signals a corner kick to Como.
40' Nico Paz (Como) has a shot blocked, it rebounds back to him, but even on his second attempt he cannot hit the target. His effort goes well wide.
38' Maxence Caqueret (Como) sees an unmarked teammate and attempts to send him a low pass. However, one of the defenders reads the game perfectly and averts the danger.
38' Alberto Arena interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Gabriel Strefezza (Como).
34' Nico Paz (Como) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
34' The assistant referee raises his flag and the referee blows his whistle. Morten Thorsby (Genoa) puts the ball into the net, but he is flagged for offside.
31' Nico Paz (Como) clips a neat ball into the box in the direction of Patrick Cutrone, but he can't get on the end of the pass.
31' Gabriel Strefezza (Como) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
30' Jonathan Ikone (Como) rises high to head a nice lofted cross towards the middle of the goal. Unfortunately for him, his close-range effort lacks pace and Nicola Leali makes a comfortable save.
28' Honest Ahanor (Genoa) receives a lofted pass from the side and shoots from the edge of the penalty area, but the ball flies onto the left post!
27' Patrick Cutrone (Como) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play.
26' Alberto Arena blows his whistle and signals a foul after Jonathan Ikone (Como) brought his opponent down.
24' Mergim Vojvoda (Como) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Nicola Leali intercepts the ball.
22' Jonathan Ikone (Como) is adjudged offside.
22' Aaron Martin (Genoa) sends a cross into the box, but Jean Butez comes off his line to gather the ball.
20' Edoardo Goldaniga (Como) latches on to a sweet cross inside the box and misses with a header high above the bar.
19' Como take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
19' Gabriel Strefezza (Como) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared. The ball is out of play and Como manage to earn a corner.
18' Mergim Vojvoda (Como) attempts to find his teammate with a final pass from outside of the box, but one of the defenders clears the ball to safety.
16' Nico Paz (Como) creates some space for himself to pick up a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a decent strike which goes a whisker over the crossbar.
16' Maxence Caqueret (Como) works the corner short.

15' Jonathan Ikone (Como) goes on a mazy run and tries his luck with a mid-range strike, but one of the defending players steps in and makes a block. The ball goes out of play and Como have been awarded a corner kick.
14' Jonathan Ikone (Como) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
12' Patrick Cutrone (Como) was all set to receive a beautiful pass into a promising position. However, one of the defenders makes a timely clearance.
10' Gabriel Strefezza (Como) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
10' Patrick Cutrone (Como) meets a cross inside the box, but Nicola Leali wins the battle for the ball and the chance is gone.
10' Patrizio Masini (Genoa) is penalised after knocking an opponent down.
8' Lior Kassa (Genoa) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Alberto Arena blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion.
8' Gabriel Strefezza (Como) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
5' Lior Kassa (Genoa) receives a well-played pass inside the penalty area and shoots. He sends the ball into orbit.
4' The referee blows his whistle, a clear handball by Nico Paz (Como).
3' Gabriel Strefezza (Como) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
2' Lior Kassa (Genoa) attempts to find some of his teammates with a dangerous pass from the edge of the box. The opponent's defence, however, intercepts the effort and clears the ball to safety.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Como will kick the game off.
Alberto Arena will supervise the game today.
Show lineups The starting lineups of both teams are already revealed and you can check them out in the details of this match.
